description: List tickets from a specific Zendesk view, with optional sorting and cursor pagination. This read-only action can be used to analyze tickets matching the view's conditions; retrieve additional pages as needed.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing tickets from a specific view.

page_after.description: Cursor value to retrieve the next page of results. Obtained from previous response's 'next_page' URL.
page_after.human_parameter_description: Cursor token from previous response to get the next page of results.
page_after.title: Page After

page_before.description: Cursor value to retrieve the previous page of results. Obtained from previous response's 'previous_page' URL.
page_before.human_parameter_description: Cursor token from previous response to get the previous page of results.
page_before.title: Page Before

page_size.description: Number of tickets per page for cursor pagination (max 100). Use cursor-based pagination for large datasets.
page_size.human_parameter_description: Number of tickets to return per page for cursor-based pagination. Use for large datasets.
page_size.title: Page Size

sort_by.description: Sort or group the tickets by a column in the View columns table. The 'subject' and 'submitter' columns are not supported for sorting.
sort_by.human_parameter_description: The field to sort tickets by. Note that 'subject' and 'submitter' columns are not supported for sorting.
sort_by.title: Sort By

sort_order.description: Sort order direction. One of 'asc' or 'desc'. Defaults to 'asc' for alphabetical and position sort, 'desc' for all others.
sort_order.human_parameter_description: Choose ascending (asc) or descending (desc) order for the sorting.
sort_order.title: Sort Order

view_id.description: The ID of the view to retrieve tickets from
view_id.human_parameter_description: The numeric ID of the view whose tickets you want to retrieve. You can find this from the view list or from a view URL.
view_id.title: View Id

inputSchema.title: GetViewsTicketsRequest

name: get_views_tickets

value.title: Value
